query:
INSERT INTO imap_state_entries (link_id, kind, key, document)
        SELECT
            $1,
            'folder',
            n::text,
            jsonb_build_object(
                'folder', jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', n::text,
                    'name', n::text,
                    'role', 'other',
                    'hasChildren', false
                ),
                'monitored', n <= 200
            )
        FROM
            generate_series(1, 240) n
